courses.title: Foundation for Virtual and Augmented Reality Systems

course_goals.text: Analyze the foundational concepts, historical evolution, and inherent challenges of Extended Reality (XR) systems, including psychological dimensions and cultural applications.
Design and analyze the complete architecture of immersive XR systems, integrating hardware components, tracking mechanisms, and user-centric software development principles.
Evaluate the influence of human sensory perception and physiological processes on XR design, focusing on visual, auditory, and non-visual factors to enhance immersion.
Apply optimization techniques and rigorous empirical methods to enhance XR performance, mitigate physiological discomfort, and implement complex systems using industry tools.
